text: The root stylelint rules set selector-pseudo-element-colon-notation to double. This landing also changes before/after selector spellings in seven CSS files without changing their declarations or pseudo-class selectors. Treat the setting as a requirement for files governed by this configuration; generated/third-party exclusions and any more specific settings still need checking. It is not a claim that browsers reject legacy single-colon syntax. No lint or rendering run was performed.
title: The root CSS configuration requires double-colon pseudo-elements
